description: This bar chart illustrates the token count distribution across five categories labeled 0 through 4 on the horizontal axis, with each category represented by a stacked bar composed of two segments: a lower orange segment labeled “Reasoning” and an upper blue segment labeled “Demonstration,” as indicated by the legend. The vertical axis, labeled “Token Count,” is scaled linearly from 0 to 7000, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 1000. The chart displays five distinct bars, each corresponding to a category on the x-axis. The bar for category 0 is a single orange bar with a value of 6393 tokens, as labeled above it. The bars for categories 1 through 4 are stacked, with the orange “Reasoning” portion being significantly larger than the blue “Demonstration” portion. The bar for category 1 has an orange segment of approximately 4400 tokens and a blue segment of approximately 400 tokens, with a red arrow pointing to the top of the blue segment labeled “-1952.” The bar for category 2 has an orange segment of approximately 4600 tokens and a blue segment of approximately 400 tokens, with a red arrow pointing to the top of the blue segment labeled “-1613.” The bar for category 3 has an orange segment of approximately 5000 tokens and a blue segment of approximately 400 tokens, with a red arrow pointing to the top of the blue segment labeled “-1040.” The bar for category 4 has an orange segment of approximately 4300 tokens and a blue segment of approximately 400 tokens, with a red arrow pointing to the top of the blue segment labeled “-1379.” The bars are arranged in ascending order of their total height from left to right, with category 0 being the tallest and category 4 being the shortest among the stacked bars. There is no visual emphasis such as shading, bolding, or outlining applied to any of the bars.
